name: What features should be included for an aging parent in a father-in-law suite?
description: Essential features include zero-threshold walk-in showers, reinforced walls for grab bars, wide doorways, flush flooring transitions, and lever-style handles.

mainEntity.name: What features should be included for an aging parent in a father-in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Incorporating accessibility and aging-in-place features is best done during the initial framing and plumbing stages rather than retrofitting later. Prioritize zero-barrier walk-in showers with slip-resistant tile, built-in shower seating, and pre-blocked walls for sturdy grab bar installation. Plan for wider interior doorways and hallways to accommodate walkers or wheelchairs, along with lever-style door handles and single-handle faucets for easier grip. Flush transitions between flooring materials prevent tripping hazards. Installing rocker-style light switches at accessible heights and ensuring ample task lighting around kitchenettes also significantly improve daily comfort and safety for aging family members.
